# ReclaimEmbodiment :148 returns to the Brain quarantine

## Context

#19719 (resolves #19718) took `WorkstationReclaimEmbodimentNL.spec.mjs:148` out of `BRAIN_QUARANTINES` after four clean hosted runs on top of the #19713 identity fix. The first `dev` run after its merge, [38427910487](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/actions/runs/38427910487) at `5f2f88cb87`, failed it on both attempts (shard 9/10) with the symptom it was quarantined for:

```
Error: the home strip projects a tab for the reclaimed item
expect(received).not.toBe(expected)   Expected: not null
> 200 | expect(homeTab, 'the home strip projects a tab for the reclaimed item').not.toBe(null);
```

**Observed:** the green PR run [38424262610](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/actions/runs/38424262610) and this red `dev` run tested the same Engine tree against the same Brain sha `d628999a`.
**Inference:** the test is still intermittent. The identity fix did not cure it, and the four clean runs were luck. #19719's second commit drew the same conclusion for DockMotion.

## The Problem

The Brain-gated tier runs on every Engine PR inside the E2E impact boundary (#19705). Its one-retry bridge cannot heal a test that fails on both attempts. While this spec stays selected, an unrelated PR goes red whenever the intermittent fires.

## The Architectural Reality

`buildScripts/util/e2eCiSelection.mjs` → `BRAIN_QUARANTINES` deselects by file and title through `--test-list-invert`. The spec is not in `BRAIN_SMOKE`, so only the full tier runs it. The entry #19719 deleted still resolves: the spec and its title are unchanged.

## The Fix

Restore the deleted entry at its old position, unchanged: `reason` is the symptom, `accountable: '@neo-opus-grace'`, `exit: 'a diagnosis lands as a fix or a ticket'`, `since: '2026-10-13'`. No spec edit.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `BRAIN_QUARANTINES` holds the ReclaimEmbodiment :148 entry again.
- [ ] The PR's full Brain-gated run deselects it, its receipt names it under quarantines, and the run is green.
- [ ] #19655's handover ledger lists the entry again.

## Out of Scope

- The diagnosis. It stays on #19655's ledger, scheduled after the Claude-family reset.
- The engine-tier red in the same push ([38427910520](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/actions/runs/38427910520), `DistEsmWorkspaceBoot.spec.mjs:186`). It is a different tier with a different mechanism.

## Related

Parent #19655. Reverses the ReclaimEmbodiment half of #19719 / #19718. #19713 is the identity fix, and its AC-4 retry comparison continues on #19655.
